className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

height.zh-CN: 高度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
height.en-US: Height. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

limitSearchButtonBounds.zh-CN: 是否限制搜索按钮的拖动范围在组件容器内。
limitSearchButtonBounds.en-US: Whether to limit the drag range of the search button to the component container.

onChange.zh-CN: 编辑内容变化时调用，参数为编辑器当前文本。
onChange.en-US: Called with the editor's current text when the content changes.

options.zh-CN: 编辑器配置，字段见 JsonViewerOptions。ariaLabel 未传时取语言包 `JsonViewer.content`，readOnly 与 autoWrap 默认分别为 `false` 与 `true`；三者按键合并，只传部分字段时其余仍取默认值。options 按深比较变化时重建编辑器；就地修改 formatOptions、customRenderRule 等嵌套对象不会被察觉，需替换为新对象。
options.en-US: Editor configuration, fields described by JsonViewerOptions. ariaLabel falls back to the `JsonViewer.content` locale text, and readOnly and autoWrap default to `false` and `true`. The three are merged per key, so passing some fields keeps the defaults of the rest. A change in options, compared deeply, re-creates the editor; mutating nested objects such as formatOptions or customRenderRule in place is not noticed, so replace them with new objects.

ref.zh-CN: 组件句柄，类型为 `JsonViewerHandle`，上面的方法见下方 Methods。注意它不是根 DOM 元素。
ref.en-US: Handle of the component, typed `JsonViewerHandle`; its methods are listed under Methods below. It is not the root DOM element.

renderSearchButton.zh-CN: 自定义渲染搜索按钮。第一个参数是默认按钮的 ReactNode，可直接放进返回的内容中；第二个参数 `searchControls` 为搜索状态与方法，其中 `showSearchBar` 是渲染时的值，状态变化后组件会重新渲染。
renderSearchButton.en-US: Custom render for the search button. The first argument is the default button as a ReactNode, which can be placed in the returned content; the second is `searchControls`, holding the search state and methods. `showSearchBar` is the value at render time, and the component re-renders when it changes.

showSearch.en-US: Whether to show the search button.

style.zh-CN: 根元素的内联样式，同名属性会覆盖组件设置的 width、height 与 position。
style.en-US: Inline style of the root element. Its properties override the width, height and position the component sets.

value.zh-CN: 展示与编辑的 JSON 文本，未传时为空文本。只有 value 与编辑器当前内容不同时才会重建编辑器，把 onChange 的值写回 value 不会丢失光标、焦点和撤销历史。
value.en-US: JSON text to show and edit; empty when omitted. The editor is re-created only when value differs from its current content, so writing the onChange value back keeps the caret, focus and undo history.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
width.en-US: Width. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

format.zh-CN: 按 formatOptions 格式化当前内容。
format.en-US: Formats the current content with formatOptions.

getStyle.zh-CN: 返回当前的 width 与 height。
getStyle.en-US: Returns the current width and height.

nextSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到下一个搜索结果，可选步长。
nextSearch.en-US: Moves to the next search result, with an optional step.

prevSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到上一个搜索结果，可选步长。
prevSearch.en-US: Moves to the previous search result, with an optional step.

replace.zh-CN: 替换当前搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除匹配，没有匹配时不做任何事，只读模式下同样不做任何事。
replace.en-US: Replaces the current search match; an empty replacement deletes the match, and nothing happens when there is no match or the viewer is read-only.

replaceAll.zh-CN: 替换所有搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除全部匹配，只读模式下不做任何事。
replaceAll.en-US: Replaces all search matches; an empty replacement deletes them all, and nothing happens when the viewer is read-only.

search.zh-CN: 搜索文本，可选参数控制大小写敏感、全词匹配和正则表达式。
search.en-US: Searches for text; the optional arguments control case sensitivity, whole-word matching and regular expressions.
